newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Mudslides kill eight in northeastern Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Mudslides kill eight in northeastern Brazil.

text.p: Mudslides triggered by heavy rain in northeastern Brazil killed eight people, including a family of five, and made 38 families homeless, authorities said on Monday.
Mud buried dozens of shanties on hillsides around the city of Salvador, some 1,200 miles (2,000 km) north of Sao Paulo in the state of Bahia, a Civil Defence spokesman said.
On Saturday and Sunday the coastal city was pounded by torrential rain that had let up by Monday, the spokesman said.
More than 120 Brazilians have died since the beginning of the year in floods and mudslides, authorities said.
